name: Rye (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Rye (Secale cereale) [Cereals and cereal products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 168884 (Rye grain, SR Legacy) - macros, individual sugars, full amino-acid profile, vitamins, minerals, fatty acids
Rye Flour and Rye Bran: New Perspectives for Use, Processes 2022, 10, 293, doi:10.3390/pr10020293 - organic acids (quinic 0.64, malic 0.16 g/100g flour; citric 0.471 g/100g bran)
Karppinen et al. / Rakha et al., fructan content of rye (1.7-6.6 g/100g dry matter)
Nutrition Journal 2017, doi:10.1186/s12937-017-0246-5 and GLNC - whole-rye starch 56-70% of dry matter
Nutritional Values and Biochemical Traits of Rye (Secale cereale L.) Seeds, PMC11988677 - cross-check protein/lipid/mineral/AA/fatty-acid ranges (Se 33 ug/100g landrace)
Rye phenolic/ferulic acid literature (Andersson et al.) - ferulic acid, alkylresorcinols, lignans
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy source is STARCH (~55 g/100g), followed by fructans (~4 g/100g) and quinic acid (0.64 g/100g, the dominant organic acid and previously wholly missing); free sugars are minor (sucrose 0.71 > glucose 0.16 > fructose 0.11 g/100g). Rye is protein-modest (10.3 g, Glx/Pro-rich, Lys-limiting), lipid-poor (1.6 g, linoleic-dominant), and mineral-rich (K, P, Mg, Mn, Zn). Organic acids (quinic, malic, citric, plus minor lactic/acetic/succinic/oxalic) were the key growth-relevant gap
curation_added: quinic acid (0.64 g/100g - dominant organic acid, was absent)
citric, lactic, acetic, succinic, oxalic acids (present)
starch amount (~55 g/100g - dominant carbon source)
total fructans (~4 g/100g - major fermentable oligosaccharide)
individual sugar amounts (sucrose 0.71, glucose 0.16, fructose 0.11 g/100g)
quantitative vitamins B1/B2/B3/B5/B6/B9, choline, E, K
quantitative minerals (K, P, Mg, Ca, Fe, Zn, Mn, Se)

curation_removed.name: Creatine cytosol
curation_removed.reason: Animal muscle metabolite; not synthesized by cereal grain. FooDB predicted/implausible in a plant matrix.

curation_removed.name: Taurine C2H7NO3S
curation_removed.reason: Animal-specific sulfonic amino acid; absent from plant grains. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed (animal) vitamin A; rye contains provitamin carotenoids (trace), not retinol. Remove; keep beta-carotene as trace phytochemical.

curation_removed.name: Serotonin
curation_removed.reason: Predicted trace biogenic amine, not a growth nutrient; FooDB noise for a growth medium.

curation_removed.name: Dopamine
curation_removed.reason: Predicted trace catecholamine; not a quantitatively relevant growth nutrient. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: 4-Hydroxyproline / cis-4-Hydroxyproline
curation_removed.reason: Collagen-associated (animal) imino acid; not a free grain nutrient. FooDB predicted artifact.

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria / Iron (Fe3+) (duplicate iron entries)
curation_removed.reason: Compartment/oxidation-state duplicates of the same nutrient; consolidated into a single 'iron' component (2.67 mg/100g).

curation_removed.name: Cobalt (Co2+)
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace; retained only as B12 cofactor context. No plant B12; drop as a defined growth nutrient (keep as trace only if the model needs Co).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
